newsitem.title: SWEDEN: NATO'S Solana says no Russia deal this year.
newsitem.headline: NATO'S Solana says no Russia deal this year.

text.p: NATO Secretary-General Javier Solana said on Wednesday that no deal on future relations between Russia and NATO would be signed this year.
"No formal signature will take place in 1996," Solana told a news conference during the first official visit of a NATO chief to neutral Sweden.
Solana was quoted by the Russian news agency Interfax on Tuesday as saying that he hoped to sign a deal with Moscow by the end of the year.
NATO officials travelling with Solana said the Russian report was incorrect.
Arriving in Stockholm for a brief visit, Solana said he saw talks with Russia over a planned document on future relations as part of a process which would culminate in mid-1997.
He emphasised that any deal with Russia was not linked to the enlargement of NATO. "There is no relationship between the enlargement and the bilateral relations with Russia," he said.
